name: multivision
description: Connect Codex to a scoped MultiVision instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped MultiVision tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to MultiVision through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so MultiVision Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use MultiVision only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
